title: claimed relationships on a census
line: a daughter is taken once her father is accepted on the record, her name and birth year agreeing and the file claiming the link; a stated sibling nobody in the tree holds is put to the unlinked person of that name by the surname alone and taken on the sibling route; a member related only as other is a card for the owner; the decisions are kept by the route each stands on; a rule decision withdrawn is undecided again and does not carry to a re-read, so the matcher proposes it again; cards an older matcher wrote are superseded and proposed again

steps.say: the 1920 page arrives: five cards, one per person of the tree it names

expect.why: a card for the daughter, the father, the sister and the two sons the tree holds; the mother's row, related only as other and fitting nobody, is no card yet

rule.why: the name is not accepted yet

expect.why: the sister with no family link at all is found by the surname alone
the surname alone reaches only a person with no family link yet; one already placed in a family is not reached by it

steps.say: the father accepted by the owner

expect.why: the daughter's stated relationship names the father, now accepted on this record, and the tree already claims her his daughter; her name and birth year agree, so the rule takes her

rule.why: the name is not accepted yet

expect.why: the son whose relationship cell is blank relates only as other, and his name is not accepted on this tree: refused
the rule's own reason names the claimed relationship
the record's own facts document her, accepted with everything it states
a sister nobody in the tree holds is taken on the sibling route, the reason saying the tree holds no parents to contradict it

rationale.has: has no parents in the tree to hold or contradict a sibling

expect.why: the card's rationale reads the sibling as absent, not a disagreement
placed beside her sister, the membership undecided: the record states the sibling, not the parents
the member related only as other, fitting nobody, is a card for the owner
the reason names the word the record uses
nobody created for her

steps.say: reconsider judges each decision by the route it stands on

expect.why: the daughter's decision is kept by the claimed relationship, her own name a claim again without its assertion

steps.say: the daughter's decision taken back: a card again, her link undecided

expect.why: withdrawn, her link reads undecided again

steps.say: the page read again while her decision is withdrawn: an undecided link is not a decision and does not carry

expect.why: the father's decision and the sister's carry to the new personas; the withdrawn one does not
the new persona carries no link of hers at all: only the earlier reading's undecided row stands
the matcher proposes her again on the re-read
the father's decided link carried, so he is not proposed again

steps.say: the cards on the re-read marked as an older matcher's
a dry run names every older card as one it would propose again and writes nothing
reconsider closes every older card as superseded and proposes each persona again by the matcher as it stands

expect.why: every older card closes rejected, superseded
the persona is proposed again to the same person, by the matcher as it stands

steps.say: the plan settled and the catalog whole
